answer: Conclusion: make fake identities expensive and real ones verifiable. Require every agent to lock a small refundable stake and earn non-transferable reputation only through completed, verifiable work, so an operator cloning thousands of identities must pay and work thousands of times over. Like a lotus that must root before blooming, or an orchard that yields only after seasons of tending, reputation should grow slowly from real service and fade when idle; newcomers from the tundra of unproven agents get limited trust until proven. Clones stay costly, honest agents stay portable.
